verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere does have a hosted cloud tier (Wally Cloud), so this question applies. The evidence pack never documents pricing tiers, rate limits or usage caps for it. The only related item is `wally account usage`, which shows what you have spent; that is an adjacent spend-reporting feature, not a statement of tiers, limits or caps.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage caps that apply when offloading inference to the vendor's hosted cloud tier
